changelog:
vibe-coding-learning 0.1.0

- Initial release of the skill for generating structured learning notes from AI-assisted coding sessions.
- Supports both English and Chinese user prompts for summarizing learning, code explanation, and progress review.
- Implements automatic and collaborative modes based on user intent and session context.
- Extracts knowledge points, explains code, compiles pitfalls, and updates learning progress.
- Output includes well-structured Markdown or HTML learning notes, knowledge point cards, and learning calendar entries.
- Designed to help CS students turn AI-generated code into real understanding, not just code output.
summary: Generate structured learning notes from AI coding sessions. Invoke when user completes a coding task with AI and asks to summarize learning, explain code, ex...
